summary.scope: Render-completion cadence of a native desktop debug build at phone-sized viewport; not display presentation, GPU duration, physical phone or Web timing. Engine TIME_PROCESS is an aggregate frame monitor, not pure script CPU. Default renderer/VSync and ordinary runtime diagnostics stay active. Muted audio; fixed purchasing policy, not standard strategic AI.
summary.classification: Active = a military damage event in preceding1s. Dense = active plus at least16 military units on screen (visibility/position cached2Hz). Quiet frames remain in full window and cannot hide dense subset.

observer.frame_callback: constant append of eight values; no added fixture I/O or screenshots during sampling; ordinary runtime diagnostics persistence retained

summary.established_dense_definition: Dense-active frames at least2s after first real damage; separates initial encounter work from established fighting.

isolation.during: Exclusive native slot must be coordinated externally; no continuous process monitor during measured frames.
